# Notebook setup

GLLVMs of the reef BCM communities at three levels: ASVs of the 50 most abundant genera, the 5 most abundant phyla, and all genera. Followed by nitrogen-species models.

GLLVMs need **read counts**, so this script uses the filtered count phyloseq (`reef_counts`), not the TSS object (`reef_tss`) used in scripts 2 and 3. Object names, site names, shapes and phylum colours follow scripts 2 and 3.

Models take hours to fit. Every model is saved in `outputs/models/reefs/` and loaded from there:

- a model whose file exists is **loaded**;
- a model whose file is missing is **fitted** (and saved);
- set `refit_models <- TRUE` to refit all models.

Model settings (setup chunk): `use_offset` (sequencing-depth offset), `n_init` (starting values), `drop_unidentified` (exclude ASVs without a genus) and `sig_rule`. File names get a suffix for these settings (e.g. `_offset_noUnid`), so models fitted with different settings are kept apart; with the offset and the exclusion switched off, the original saved models are loaded.

Outputs: `figures/6.gllvm/F<n>_<name>.pdf` and `outputs/6.gllvm/T<n>_<name>.docx` (+ `.csv`).

```{r setup, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
packages_used <- c("dplyr", "tidyr", "tibble", "ggplot2", "ggrepel", "ggtext",
                   "phyloseq", "gllvm", "corrplot", "gclus",
                   "flextable", "officer", "beepr", "tidylog")

suppressMessages(invisible(lapply(packages_used, library, character.only = TRUE)))

missing_pkgs <- setdiff(packages_used, .packages())
if (length(missing_pkgs) == 0) message("All packages loaded correctly") else
  message("Packages that did not load: ", paste(missing_pkgs, collapse = ", "))
rm(packages_used, missing_pkgs)

theme_set(theme_bw())
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
set_flextable_defaults(theme_fun = theme_vanilla, font.size = 10, bold_header = TRUE)

refit_models <- FALSE                 # TRUE = refit every model (hours)
model_dir    <- "outputs/models/reefs"
p_adj_method <- "BH"                  # same correction as scripts 2 and 3

# ---- Model settings ----
use_offset        <- TRUE      # log(total filtered reads per sample) as offset for sequencing depth
n_init            <- 3         # starting values per fit; the best fit is kept
drop_unidentified <- TRUE      # exclude ASVs without a genus ("Unidentified") from the response
sig_rule          <- "p_adj"   # "p_adj" = p adjusted with p_adj_method; "ci" = 95% CI excludes 0 (no correction)

# Model files get a suffix for these settings, so models fitted with different settings never
# overwrite each other. With use_offset = FALSE and drop_unidentified = FALSE the original saved
# models (no offset, single start, "Unidentified" included) are loaded.
model_suffix <- paste0(if (use_offset) "_offset" else "", if (drop_unidentified) "_noUnid" else "")

fig_dir <- "figures/6.gllvm"
tab_dir <- "outputs/6.gllvm"
for (d in c(fig_dir, tab_dir, model_dir)) dir.create(d, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# ---- Output helpers (same as scripts 2 and 3) ----
save_fig <- function(plot, name, width = 11, height = 11) {
  ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, paste0(name, ".pdf")), plot = plot,
         device = cairo_pdf, width = width, height = height, units = "in")
}

# Base-graphics figures (coefplot, residual plots, corrplot): drawn in the document and saved as PDF
save_base_fig <- function(name, draw, width = 11, height = 11) {
  draw()
  cairo_pdf(file.path(fig_dir, paste0(name, ".pdf")), width = width, height = height)
  draw()
  dev.off()
  invisible()
}

save_tab <- function(tables, name) {
  if (is.data.frame(tables)) tables <- setNames(list(tables), name)
  doc <- read_docx()
  for (nm in names(tables)) {
    doc <- body_add_par(doc, nm, style = "Normal")
    doc <- body_add_flextable(doc, autofit(flextable(tables[[nm]])))
    doc <- body_add_par(doc, "")
  }
  print(doc, target = file.path(tab_dir, paste0(name, ".docx")))
  for (nm in names(tables)) {
    suffix <- if (length(tables) > 1) paste0("_", gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", nm)) else ""
    write.csv(tables[[nm]], file.path(tab_dir, paste0(name, suffix, ".csv")), row.names = FALSE)
  }
}

# Community matrix (samples as rows) from a phyloseq object, whatever its orientation
otu_matrix <- function(ps) {
  m <- as(otu_table(ps), "matrix")
  if (taxa_are_rows(ps)) m <- t(m)
  m
}

message(paste0(utf8::as_utf8("\U0001f600"), " All good!"))
```

# Data

## Phyloseq, taxonomy and metadata

```{r data}
# Filtered COUNT phyloseq (GLLVMs need counts; scripts 2-3 use the TSS version reef_tss)
reef_counts <- readRDS("data/bcms_filtered_reefs_raja2023.rds")

community.counts <- otu_matrix(reef_counts)   # samples x ASVs, raw counts
if (any(community.counts != round(community.counts)))
  warning("community.counts contains non-integer values: negative binomial models need counts")

# Taxonomy with an ASV column (same object name as in script 2)
tax_df <- as.data.frame(as(tax_table(reef_counts), "matrix")) %>%
  rownames_to_column("ASV")

# Sample metadata with display site names (same object name as in scripts 2 and 3)
env <- as(sample_data(reef_counts), "data.frame") %>%
  filter(!is.na(site))
stopifnot(all(unique(env$site) %in% names(site_labels)))
env <- env %>% mutate(site = factor(site_labels[site], levels = site_levels))
rownames(env) <- env$sample_id

# Scaled predictors from the correlation/collinearity script (used as X)
env_scaled <- read.csv("data/environmental_scaled_filtered_reefs.csv", row.names = 1)
stopifnot(all(names(env_vars) %in% colnames(env_scaled)))
```

## GLLVM helpers

```{r gllvm helpers}
# Rename unassigned taxa consistently (older models used "Unknown")
normalize_taxa <- function(x) sub("^Unknown$", "Unidentified", x)

# Sum ASV counts per taxonomic rank (NA -> "Unidentified"); optionally keep only some taxa
# drop = TRUE removes the pooled "Unidentified" column (see drop_unidentified)
aggregate_taxa <- function(counts, rank, keep = NULL, drop = drop_unidentified) {
  lab <- tax_df[[rank]][match(colnames(counts), tax_df$ASV)]
  lab[is.na(lab)] <- "Unidentified"
  if (!is.null(keep)) {
    sel    <- lab %in% keep
    counts <- counts[, sel, drop = FALSE]
    lab    <- lab[sel]
  }
  out <- t(rowsum(t(counts), group = lab))
  if (drop) out <- out[, colnames(out) != "Unidentified", drop = FALSE]
  out
}

# Y, X and study design with the same samples in the same order
prep_gllvm <- function(Y, X_source = env_scaled) {
  Y   <- as.matrix(Y)
  Y   <- Y[rowSums(Y) > 0, , drop = FALSE]
  ids <- Reduce(intersect, list(rownames(Y), rownames(X_source), rownames(env)))
  dropped <- setdiff(rownames(Y), ids)
  if (length(dropped) > 0)
    message("Samples dropped (missing predictors or metadata): ", paste(dropped, collapse = ", "))
  Y <- Y[ids, , drop = FALSE]
  Y <- Y[, colSums(Y) > 0, drop = FALSE]
  X      <- X_source[ids, , drop = FALSE]
  design <- env[ids, c("site", "biotic_abiotic", "direct_substrate"), drop = FALSE]
  stopifnot(identical(rownames(Y), rownames(X)),
            identical(rownames(Y), rownames(design)),
            !anyNA(design$site))
  message(nrow(Y), " samples x ", ncol(Y), " taxa")
  list(Y = Y, X = X, design = design)
}

# Negative binomial GLLVM with a random site intercept
# Offset (use_offset): log of the total filtered reads of each sample, calculated from ALL
# filtered ASVs (community.counts), not only the modelled taxa, so it does not depend on
# which taxa are included. n_init starting values guard against local optima.
fit_nb <- function(d, formula = NULL, num.lv = 2, sd.errors = TRUE) {
  args <- list(y = d$Y, studyDesign = d$design, family = "negative.binomial",
               row.eff = ~(1 | site), num.lv = num.lv, sd.errors = sd.errors,
               n.init = n_init, seed = 123)
  if (use_offset) {
    lib_size    <- rowSums(community.counts)[rownames(d$Y)]
    args$offset <- matrix(log(lib_size), nrow = nrow(d$Y), ncol = ncol(d$Y))
  }
  if (!is.null(formula)) {
    args$X       <- d$X
    args$formula <- formula
  }
  do.call(gllvm, args)
}

# Load a saved model; fit and save it if the file is missing (or refit_models = TRUE)
fit_or_load <- function(file, fit_expr) {
  path <- file.path(model_dir, paste0(file, model_suffix, ".rds"))
  if (!refit_models && file.exists(path)) return(readRDS(path))
  message("Fitting ", file, " ...")
  t0 <- Sys.time()
  m  <- fit_expr                       # evaluated only here
  message(file, " fitted in ", format(round(Sys.time() - t0, 1)))
  saveRDS(m, path)
  gc()
  m
}

# Warn if a saved model was fitted on different data than the current Y
check_model_data <- function(m, d, name) {
  ok <- nrow(m$y) == nrow(d$Y) &&
        setequal(normalize_taxa(colnames(m$y)), normalize_taxa(colnames(d$Y)))
  if (!ok) warning(name, ": saved model was fitted on different data (",
                   nrow(m$y), " x ", ncol(m$y), " vs current ",
                   nrow(d$Y), " x ", ncol(d$Y), ")")
  invisible(ok)
}

# AIC table (AICc from gllvm when available)
aicc_safe <- function(m) tryCatch(AICc(m),
                                  error = function(e) tryCatch(AICc.gllvm(m),
                                                               error = function(e) NA_real_))
aic_table <- function(models, label = "Model") {
  tibble(Model     = names(models),
         n_LV      = sapply(models, function(m) m$num.lv),
         converged = sapply(models, function(m) isTRUE(m$convergence)),
         logLik    = sapply(models, function(m) as.numeric(logLik(m))),
         df        = sapply(models, function(m) attr(logLik(m), "df")),
         AIC       = sapply(models, AIC),
         AICc      = sapply(models, aicc_safe),
         BIC       = sapply(models, BIC)) %>%
    mutate(dAIC = AIC - min(AIC)) %>%
    arrange(AIC) %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 2))) %>%
    rename(!!label := Model)
}

# Likelihood-ratio test between nested models (same number of latent variables)
compare_gllvm <- function(model_reduced, model_full) {
  stopifnot(inherits(model_reduced, "gllvm"), inherits(model_full, "gllvm"))
  if (!model_reduced$convergence || !model_full$convergence)
    warning("One or both models did not converge. Results may be unreliable.")
  if (model_reduced$num.lv != model_full$num.lv)
    warning("Models have different numbers of latent variables: they are not nested.")
  LL_full  <- logLik(model_full)
  LL_red   <- logLik(model_reduced)
  df_diff  <- attr(LL_full, "df") - attr(LL_red, "df")
  LRT_stat <- max(0, 2 * (as.numeric(LL_full) - as.numeric(LL_red)))
  tibble(LRT = LRT_stat, df = df_diff,
         p   = pchisq(LRT_stat, df = df_diff, lower.tail = FALSE),
         AIC_reduced = AIC(model_reduced), AIC_full = AIC(model_full))
}

# Sample scores (first two LVs) joined with raw environmental values
lv_df <- function(m) {
  as.data.frame(getLV(m)[, 1:2, drop = FALSE]) %>%
    setNames(c("LV1", "LV2")) %>%
    rownames_to_column("sample_id") %>%
    left_join(env %>% select(sample_id, site, any_of(c(names(env_vars), names(env_vars_N)))),
              by = "sample_id")
}

# Taxa with the largest loadings (length of the loading vector on LV1-LV2)
top_loadings <- function(m, n = 10, labels = NULL) {
  th <- m$params$theta[, 1:2, drop = FALSE]
  out <- data.frame(taxon = rownames(th), LV1 = th[, 1], LV2 = th[, 2]) %>%
    mutate(length = sqrt(LV1^2 + LV2^2)) %>%
    slice_max(length, n = n, with_ties = FALSE)
  out$label <- if (is.null(labels)) out$taxon else unname(labels[out$taxon])
  out
}

# Ordination of samples coloured by an environmental variable, optionally with top taxa.
# Taxon loadings are rescaled to the range of the sample scores for display only.
ord_plot <- function(m, colour_var, title, n_taxa = 0, labels = NULL, var_labels = env_vars) {
  df <- lv_df(m)
  p <- ggplot(df, aes(LV1, LV2)) +
    geom_point(aes(colour = .data[[colour_var]], shape = site), size = 3, stroke = 1.1) +
    scale_colour_viridis_c(name = parse(text = var_labels[[colour_var]])) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = shape_sites, name = "Site") +
    labs(x = "Latent variable 1", y = "Latent variable 2", title = title) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom", panel.grid = element_blank())
  if (n_taxa > 0) {
    tl <- top_loadings(m, n_taxa, labels)
    k  <- 0.8 * max(abs(df[, c("LV1", "LV2")])) / max(abs(tl[, c("LV1", "LV2")]))
    tl <- tl %>% mutate(LV1 = LV1 * k, LV2 = LV2 * k)
    p <- p +
      geom_point(data = tl, aes(LV1, LV2), shape = 3, size = 2, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
      geom_text_repel(data = tl, aes(LV1, LV2, label = label), size = 3,
                      max.overlaps = 20, box.padding = 0.3, point.padding = 0.5,
                      inherit.aes = FALSE)
  }
  p
}

# Coefficients with Wald 95% CI, p-values and adjusted p-values (per predictor)
coef_table <- function(m) {
  est <- m$params$Xcoef
  se  <- m$sd$Xcoef
  if (is.null(se)) stop("Model has no standard errors: refit with sd.errors = TRUE")
  dimnames(se) <- dimnames(est)
  long <- function(x, v) as.data.frame(x) %>% rownames_to_column("Taxon") %>%
    pivot_longer(-Taxon, names_to = "Variable", values_to = v)
  long(est, "Estimate") %>%
    left_join(long(se, "SE"), by = c("Taxon", "Variable")) %>%
    mutate(Taxon = normalize_taxa(Taxon),
           cilow = Estimate - qnorm(0.975) * SE,
           ciup  = Estimate + qnorm(0.975) * SE,
           ci_excludes_0 = cilow > 0 | ciup < 0,
           p = 2 * pnorm(-abs(Estimate / SE))) %>%
    group_by(Variable) %>%
    mutate(p_adj = p.adjust(p, method = p_adj_method)) %>%
    ungroup()
}

# Phylum of each genus: most common phylum among its ASVs
genus_phylum <- tax_df %>%
  mutate(Genus = ifelse(is.na(Genus), "Unidentified", Genus)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Phylum)) %>%
  dplyr::count(Genus, Phylum) %>%
  group_by(Genus) %>%
  slice_max(n, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(Genus, Phylum) %>%
  mutate(Phylum = ifelse(Genus == "Unidentified", "Unidentified", Phylum))

# Coloured (phylum) and italic (genus) axis labels for ggtext::element_markdown
taxon_labels <- function(taxa) {
  ph  <- as.character(genus_phylum$Phylum[match(taxa, genus_phylum$Genus)])
  col <- unname(phylum_colors[ph])
  col[is.na(col)] <- "black"
  txt <- ifelse(taxa == "Unidentified", taxa, paste0("<i>", taxa, "</i>"))
  setNames(paste0("<span style='color:", col, "'>", txt, "</span>"), taxa)
}

# Genus label of each ASV (for biplots)
asv_genus_label <- setNames(ifelse(is.na(tax_df$Genus), "Unidentified", tax_df$Genus), tax_df$ASV)
```

#--------------------------

# 1. ASVs in the top 50 most abundant genera

Unassigned ASVs are treated as one group ("Unidentified"). With `drop_unidentified = TRUE` this group is excluded and the top 50 are 50 named genera; with `FALSE` (original analysis) unassigned ASVs are included if that group ranks in the top 50.

```{r asv top50 data}
asv_tot <- colSums(community.counts)
asv_gen <- tax_df$Genus[match(names(asv_tot), tax_df$ASV)]
asv_gen[is.na(asv_gen)] <- "Unidentified"

genus_tot <- tapply(asv_tot, asv_gen, sum)
if (drop_unidentified) genus_tot <- genus_tot[names(genus_tot) != "Unidentified"]
top50_genera <- names(sort(genus_tot, decreasing = TRUE))[1:50]
top_asvs     <- names(asv_tot)[asv_gen %in% top50_genera]

d_asv <- prep_gllvm(community.counts[, top_asvs, drop = FALSE])
```

## 1.1 Data exploration

```{r asv mean variance}
mean_var_plot <- function(Y, title) {
  data.frame(mean = colMeans(Y), var = apply(Y, 2, var)) %>%
    filter(mean > 0) %>%
    ggplot(aes(mean, var)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.5) +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +   # Poisson: variance = mean
    scale_x_log10() + scale_y_log10() +
    labs(x = "Mean count", y = "Variance", title = title) +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank())
}

p_mv_asv <- mean_var_plot(d_asv$Y, "ASVs of the top 50 genera")
p_mv_asv
save_fig(p_mv_asv, "F1_mean_variance_asv", width = 6, height = 6)
```

Variance increases much faster than the mean (points far above the 1:1 line): the data are overdispersed, so a negative binomial distribution is used.

# 2. GLLVM ASVs: unconstrained models

## 2.1 Number of latent variables

Null models (no predictors) with 0, 1 and 2 latent variables. Standard errors are not needed to compare them.

```{r asv null models}
gllvm_null0lv_reef <- fit_or_load("gllvm_null0lv_reef", fit_nb(d_asv, num.lv = 0, sd.errors = FALSE))
gllvm_null1lv_reef <- fit_or_load("gllvm_null1lv_reef", fit_nb(d_asv, num.lv = 1, sd.errors = FALSE))
gllvm_null_reef    <- fit_or_load("gllvm_null_reef",    fit_nb(d_asv, num.lv = 2, sd.errors = FALSE))  # 2 LV

for (nm in c("gllvm_null0lv_reef", "gllvm_null1lv_reef", "gllvm_null_reef"))
  check_model_data(get(nm), d_asv, nm)

aic_null_asv <- aic_table(list("~ null, 0 LV" = gllvm_null0lv_reef,
                               "~ null, 1 LV" = gllvm_null1lv_reef,
                               "~ null, 2 LV" = gllvm_null_reef), "Model (ASVs)")
aic_null_asv
```

Previous run: AIC 0 LV = 212428.5, 1 LV = 207005.5, 2 LV = 205269.7. AIC is lowest with 2 latent variables, so all models below use 2 LVs.

Residual diagnostics of the 2-LV null model

```{r asv null residuals, fig.width = 12, fig.height = 6}

}, width = 12, height = 6)
```

Slight clustering of fitted values around 0-5, probably from the many zeros; acceptable.

# 3. GLLVM ASVs + environment

```{r asv env models}
gllvm_din_reef    <- fit_or_load("gllvm_din",          fit_nb(d_asv, ~ DIN))          # file name kept
gllvm_chla_reef   <- fit_or_load("gllvm_chla_reef",    fit_nb(d_asv, ~ chla))
gllvm_temp_reef   <- fit_or_load("gllvm_temp_reef",    fit_nb(d_asv, ~ temperature))
gllvm_po4_reef    <- fit_or_load("gllvm_po4_reef",     fit_nb(d_asv, ~ mean.PO4))
gllvm_dinpo4_reef <- fit_or_load("gllvm_dinpo4_reef",  fit_nb(d_asv, ~ mean.PO4 + DIN))
gllvm_all_reef    <- fit_or_load("gllvm_all_reef",     fit_nb(d_asv, ~ mean.PO4 + DIN + temperature + chla))

for (nm in c("gllvm_din_reef", "gllvm_chla_reef", "gllvm_temp_reef",
             "gllvm_po4_reef", "gllvm_dinpo4_reef", "gllvm_all_reef"))
  check_model_data(get(nm), d_asv, nm)
beep(4)
```

## 3.1 AIC table

```{r asv aic}
aic_asv <- aic_table(list(
  "~ null, 0 LV"                     = gllvm_null0lv_reef,
  "~ null, 1 LV"                     = gllvm_null1lv_reef,
  "~ null, 2 LV"                     = gllvm_null_reef,
  "~ Chl-a"                          = gllvm_chla_reef,
  "~ Temperature"                    = gllvm_temp_reef,
  "~ DIN"                            = gllvm_din_reef,
  "~ PO4"                            = gllvm_po4_reef,
  "~ DIN + PO4"                      = gllvm_dinpo4_reef,
  "~ Chl-a + Temperature + PO4 + DIN" = gllvm_all_reef), "Model (ASVs)")
aic_asv

save_tab(aic_asv, "T1_aic_gllvm_asv")
```

Previous run: lowest AIC for ~PO4 (205042.7), then the 2-LV null (205269.7) and ~DIN + PO4 (205492.5). DIN + PO4 is used for the plots below so that the effects of both nutrients can be compared, although PO4 alone fits best.

# 4. Top 5 phyla

Models on the summed counts of the 5 most abundant phyla.

```{r phylum data}
phylum_tot <- tapply(asv_tot, tax_df$Phylum[match(names(asv_tot), tax_df$ASV)], sum)

top5_phyla

d_phylum <- prep_gllvm(aggregate_taxa(community.counts, "Phylum", keep = top5_phyla))
```

## 4.1 Models

All models use a random **site** intercept. (The original DIN + PO4 model used `(1|site_type)`, which is constant in the reef-only data: that model must be refitted, so its file name is new.)

```{r phylum models}
gllvm_null_top5_phylum_reef   <- fit_or_load("gllvm_null_top5_phylum_reef",  fit_nb(d_phylum))
gllvm_din_top5_phylum_reef    <- fit_or_load("gllvm_din_top5_phylum_reef",   fit_nb(d_phylum, ~ DIN))

gllvm_dinpo4_top5_phylum_reef <- fit_or_load("gllvm_dinpo4_top5_phylum_site_reef",
                                             fit_nb(d_phylum, ~ mean.PO4 + DIN))
gllvm_all_top5_phylum_reef    <- fit_or_load("gllvm_all_top5_phylum_reef",
                                             fit_nb(d_phylum, ~ mean.PO4 + DIN + temperature + chla))

for (nm in c("gllvm_null_top5_phylum_reef", "gllvm_din_top5_phylum_reef", "gllvm_po4_top5_phylum_reef",
             "gllvm_dinpo4_top5_phylum_reef", "gllvm_all_top5_phylum_reef"))
  check_model_data(get(nm), d_phylum, nm)
beep(3)
```

#--------------------------------------

# 5. All genera

All genera, keeping genera with ≥ 1 read in ≥ 10% of samples. Unassigned ASVs are pooled as "Unidentified", which is excluded when `drop_unidentified = TRUE`. This is the dataset of `gllvm_all_genus_reef`, analysed in more detail in 6b.gllvm_all_genera_reefs.Rmd.

```{r genus data}
Y_genus <- aggregate_taxa(community.counts, "Genus")
Y_genus <- Y_genus[rowSums(Y_genus) > 0, , drop = FALSE]
Y_genus <- Y_genus[, colMeans(Y_genus >= 1) >= 0.10, drop = FALSE]

d_genus <- prep_gllvm(Y_genus)
```

## 5.1 Models

The model files keep their original base names ("top50" in the name, but they contain all genera ≥ 10% prevalence), plus the settings suffix. The original null model was fitted with **0 LV** (despite its "2lv" file name), and its loading chunk read the DIN + PO4 file instead, which is why both had AIC 25161.97. Here the 0-LV null keeps that file name and a true 2-LV null is added.

`reported_model` sets which model is used for the checks, coefficient plot and co-occurrence. Because the predictors vary only between 8 sites, a model with one or two predictors is recommended over the full four-predictor model.

```{r genus models}
gllvm_null0lv_genus_reef     <- fit_or_load("gllvm_null2lv_top50_genus_reef",    # contains the 0-LV null
                                            fit_nb(d_genus, num.lv = 0, sd.errors = FALSE))
gllvm_null2lv_genus_reef     <- fit_or_load("gllvm_null2lv_genus_reef",
                                            fit_nb(d_genus, num.lv = 2, sd.errors = FALSE))
gllvm_chla_genus_reef        <- fit_or_load("gllvm_chla_top50_genus_reef",   fit_nb(d_genus, ~ chla))
gllvm_temp_genus_reef        <- fit_or_load("gllvm_temp_top50_genus_reef",   fit_nb(d_genus, ~ temperature))
gllvm_din_genus_reef         <- fit_or_load("gllvm_din_top50_genus_reef",    fit_nb(d_genus, ~ DIN))
gllvm_po4_genus_reef         <- fit_or_load("gllvm_po4_top50_genus_reef",    fit_nb(d_genus, ~ mean.PO4))
gllvm_dinpo4_genus_reef      <- fit_or_load("gllvm_dinpo4_top50_genus_reef", fit_nb(d_genus, ~ mean.PO4 + DIN))
gllvm_allnochla_genus_reef   <- fit_or_load("gllvm_allnochla_top50_genus_reef",
                                            fit_nb(d_genus, ~ mean.PO4 + DIN + temperature))
gllvm_all_genus_reef         <- fit_or_load("gllvm_ALL_genus_reef",
                                            fit_nb(d_genus, ~ mean.PO4 + DIN + temperature + chla))

genus_models <- list(
  "~ null, 0 LV"                      = gllvm_null0lv_genus_reef,
  "~ null, 2 LV"                      = gllvm_null2lv_genus_reef,
  "~ Chl-a"                           = gllvm_chla_genus_reef,
  "~ Temperature"                     = gllvm_temp_genus_reef,
  "~ DIN"                             = gllvm_din_genus_reef,
  "~ PO4"                             = gllvm_po4_genus_reef,
  "~ DIN + PO4"                       = gllvm_dinpo4_genus_reef,
  "~ Temperature + PO4 + DIN"         = gllvm_allnochla_genus_reef,
  "~ Chl-a + Temperature + PO4 + DIN" = gllvm_all_genus_reef)

for (nm in names(genus_models)) check_model_data(genus_models[[nm]], d_genus, nm)

# Model used for checks, coefficients and co-occurrence (one of the names above)
reported_model <- "~ DIN + PO4"
stopifnot(reported_model %in% names(genus_models))
reported_genus_model <- genus_models[[reported_model]]
```

## 5.2 AIC table and likelihood-ratio tests

```{r genus aic}
aic_genus <- aic_table(genus_models, "Model (all genera)")
aic_genus

# LRTs between nested models with the same number of LVs
lrt_genus <- bind_rows(
  "PO4 vs null"                 = compare_gllvm(gllvm_null2lv_genus_reef, gllvm_po4_genus_reef),
  "DIN vs null"                 = compare_gllvm(gllvm_null2lv_genus_reef, gllvm_din_genus_reef),
  "DIN + PO4 vs PO4"            = compare_gllvm(gllvm_po4_genus_reef,     gllvm_dinpo4_genus_reef),
  "All vs DIN + PO4"            = compare_gllvm(gllvm_dinpo4_genus_reef,  gllvm_all_genus_reef),
  "All vs no Chl-a"             = compare_gllvm(gllvm_allnochla_genus_reef, gllvm_all_genus_reef),
  .id = "Comparison") %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 4)))
lrt_genus

save_tab(list("AIC" = aic_genus, "Likelihood-ratio tests" = lrt_genus), "T3_aic_lrt_gllvm_all_genera")
```

Previous run (no offset, "Unidentified" included): lowest AIC for ~PO4 (25082.19), then ~DIN (25114.64); the full model had the highest AIC (25236.17). Check the ranking again with the current settings before choosing `reported_model`.

## 5.3 Reported model checks

```{r genus checks, fig.width = 12, fig.height = 6}
reported_model
reported_genus_model$convergence

save_base_fig("F12_residuals_reported_genera", function() {
  par(mfrow = c(1, 2))
  plot(reported_genus_model, which = 1:2, var.colors = 1, n.plot = 100)
}, width = 12, height = 6)
```

## 5.4 Coefficient plot (all genera)

All genera of the reported model, with non-significant coefficients (according to `sig_rule`) in grey. The significant-only version (all-genera coefficient system) is in 6b.gllvm_all_genera_reefs.Rmd.

```{r genus coef}
coef_all_genus <- coef_table(reported_genus_model) %>%
  left_join(genus_phylum, by = c("Taxon" = "Genus")) %>%
  mutate(Phylum = ifelse(is.na(Phylum), "Unidentified", Phylum),
         Phylum = factor(Phylum, levels = unique(c(names(phylum_colors), sort(unique(Phylum))))),
         significant = if (sig_rule == "ci") ci_excludes_0 else p_adj < 0.05,
         sig_col = ifelse(significant, "black", "grey60")) %>%
  arrange(Phylum, Estimate)

genus_order <- coef_all_genus %>%
  group_by(Taxon, Phylum) %>% summarise(m = mean(Estimate), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(Phylum, m) %>% pull(Taxon)

genus_lab <- taxon_labels(genus_order)

coef_reef_genus_plot <- coef_all_genus %>%
  mutate(Taxon = factor(Taxon, levels = rev(genus_order))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(y = Taxon, x = Estimate)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = cilow, xmax = ciup, colour = sig_col), width = 0) +
  geom_point(aes(colour = sig_col), size = 1.5) +
  scale_colour_identity() +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = genus_lab) +
  facet_wrap(~ Variable, nrow = 1, scales = "free_x",
             labeller = as_labeller(env_vars, label_parsed)) +
  labs(y = NULL, x = "Coefficient (95% CI)", title = paste("Reefs: all genera,", reported_model)) +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_markdown(size = 6),
        strip.text  = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
        panel.grid  = element_blank())
coef_reef_genus_plot

save_fig(coef_reef_genus_plot, "F13_coef_all_genera",
         width = 12, height = max(8, 0.12 * length(genus_order) + 2))

write.csv(coef_all_genus %>% mutate(site_type = "reef", model = reported_model),
          file.path(tab_dir, "T4_coefficients_all_genera.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

#-------------------------------------

# 6. Co-occurrence patterns (all genera)

Residual correlations without (null, 2 LV) and with the environmental predictors (reported model). To keep the plots readable, only the 40 genera with the strongest residual correlations are shown.

```{r cooccurrence, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 10}
cr_null_genus <- getResidualCor(gllvm_null2lv_genus_reef)
cr_all_genus  <- getResidualCor(reported_genus_model)

top_cor <- function(cr, n = 40) {
  keep <- names(sort(rowMeans(abs(cr - diag(diag(cr)))), decreasing = TRUE))[seq_len(min(n, nrow(cr)))]
  cr <- cr[keep, keep]
  cr[order.single(cr), order.single(cr)]
}

draw_cor <- function(cr) function() {
  par(mar = c(4, 4, 2, 2))
  corrplot(top_cor(cr), diag = FALSE, type = "lower", method = "square",
           tl.cex = 0.5, tl.srt = 45, tl.col = "black")
}

save_base_fig("F14a_residual_cor_null_genera", draw_cor(cr_null_genus), 10, 10)
save_base_fig("F14b_residual_cor_reported_genera", draw_cor(cr_all_genus), 10, 10)
```

No clear co-occurrence structure between genera.
